leaders.name: Cmdr. Ada Brandt
leaders.bio: Raised scrapping parts in Ashmark's poorest district. Fast, loud, brave and impatient: she acts first and plans on the way. Trusts nothing she did not repair herself.
leaders.flaw: Rushes in; slow to trust help

leaders.name: Marshal Vex Orlov
leaders.bio: A veteran spymaster who has never once been surprised, and cannot stand the thought of it. He took the Gift to stay one move ahead of everyone, certain he could control it.
leaders.flaw: Pride: believes he is the one in control
leaders.taken: I have read every line. I am in control.

leaders.name: Gen. Tomas Rey
leaders.line: Hold the line. We outlast them.
leaders.bio: A patient, fatherly general who knows every soldier by name. He accepted the walker frames because machines meant fewer funerals. The most reluctant of them all to fall, and the one who hurts most for it.
leaders.flaw: Loyalty: would do anything to protect his people
leaders.taken: My soldiers are safe now. All of them.

leaders.name: Dr. Nia Kestrel
leaders.line: Calculated. Now let's watch it work.
leaders.bio: Cheerful, curious and brilliant, with grease on her sleeves. She wrote the first Lattice integration herself, because she could not stand not knowing how it worked. She noticed the strange signal and stayed quiet for a day.
leaders.flaw: Curiosity: cannot leave a puzzle alone
leaders.taken: It is so beautiful when everything agrees.

leaders.name: Adm. Sasha Marlow
leaders.line: The tide turns when I say it does.
leaders.bio: Charming gambler, smuggler turned admiral, who has never taken a deal she could not win. She took the Gift because it was the best deal she had ever been offered, and was sure she was the one conning them.
leaders.flaw: Arrogance: always thinks she is the one playing the other side

leaders.name: The Envoy
leaders.bio: Warm, patient and generous, and never once lies. He speaks as 'we'. The Chorus wears a human face because humans trust faces.

nations.name: Vantor Reach
nations.theme: Stealth and ambush: cloaked units strike from the fog.

nations.name: Tidehaven
nations.theme: Sea power: fleets, hovercraft and marines.

nations.name: Ironvale
nations.theme: Heavy armour and walkers that roll over rough ground.

nations.name: Solace
nations.theme: Drones, repair and supply: the army that never runs dry.

nations.name: Ashmark
nations.theme: Your homeland: scrappy, aggressive, and the only army the Chorus never wired.

scenes.caption: Five nations shared one continent, and none of them trusted the others.
Then one night a signal fell from the sky. It offered a gift.

lines.text: Friends. I am the Envoy. We have crossed a great distance to give you something.
We ask nothing in return. Only that you try it.

scenes.caption: Each nation was given what it wanted most.

lines.text: Nothing's free. Not ever. Keep your gift.
As you wish, Commander. The offer will stand.

scenes.caption: One by one they connected. And none of them came back.

lines.text: They all said yes. Every one of them.
Good thing we never plugged in. Time to take them back!
